outcome.answer: MoCo Rubric directly matches this approach: it improves detailed image captions using a shared vision-language model for captioning, rubric creation, and judging, with an exponential moving average model shared by the rubric generator and judge [1]. The generator creates explicit quality criteria from current captions, reference captions, and image evidence; the judge scores captions against those criteria, while policy updates help the shared momentum model track changing outputs [1].
